_status: PALETTE APPROVED by John 12 Nov 2026 (navy anchor ~30%, ivory/parchment background ~60%, gold accent ~10%, slate for secondary text). Fonts NOT final: John to supply the font names from his design (Marcellus/Inter are placeholders). Logo: John's design (C with arrow and star). Contrast rules: gold #A9844A on light is 3.1:1, so use it only for rules, icons and large text (24px+); small gold text on light uses color-brass-deep. Main button: bright gold #C9A66B with navy text on navy sections; on light sections the action colour is navy (color-pitch).

_roles.color-line: hairlines and borders on light backgrounds
_roles.color-navy: main dark brand colour: headings, dark sections
_roles.color-pitch: action colour on light backgrounds: buttons, links, check marks (navy in the Chiron palette)
_roles.color-pitch-soft: parchment: alternate sections, booking band, hover tint
_roles.color-brass: accent: eyebrows on dark, icons, markers
_roles.color-brass-deep: accent dark enough for small text on light backgrounds
_roles.color-gold: gold for rules, icons and large text on light backgrounds (not small text: 3.1:1)

font-serif._role: headings (the label says serif for compatibility with the class library; any heading font works)
